title: Rate Committee Bulletin: Contract Rate on Authorisation of Automatic Debit — Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
When a member authorises automatic debit on a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage, the contract rate from that day is set as follows.

## The FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage

The rate is the Association Variable Base Rate in effect on the change date — **6.75 percent** since its most recent history date — plus the product's variable-rate spread, less the discount, the discount taken off being the product's autopay discount, capped at the product's discount cap. The result is rounded to 3 decimal places and may not be lower than the product's rate floor.

## Every other FarmLand product

The new rate is the contract rate in force less the product's autopay discount, that discount being no more than the product's discount cap, rounded to 3 decimal places and never below the product's rate floor.

## Which paragraph applies

| Product | Rate from the change date |
|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage (no fixed period) | base rate plus spread, less the capped autopay discount; rounded; floored |
| FarmLand 3-Year, 5-Year or 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage, or 15-Year or 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | contract rate in force less the capped autopay discount; rounded; floored |

## Worked figures (hypothetical product inputs)

**Variable-rate loan.** Take, for the illustration, a spread of 0.25, an autopay discount of 0.10, a discount cap of 0.5 and a floor of 5.0. The base rate on the change date is 6.75. 6.75 plus 0.25 is 7.00; the discount of 0.10 is within the cap; 7.00 less 0.10 is 6.900, above the floor. The contract rate from the change date is **6.900 percent**.

**Adjustable loan.** Take a loan carrying a contract rate of 6.850 percent, with an autopay discount of 0.10, a cap of 0.5 and a floor of 5.25. 6.850 less 0.10 is **6.750 percent**, above the floor.

**Floor at work.** Were the contract rate in force 5.300 percent on a product with a 0.10 autopay discount and a 5.25 floor, 5.300 less 0.10 would be 5.200, below the floor, and the rate would be **5.250 percent**.
